title: News breaking story
description: Written by the news agent to ~/agent-house/desks/news/breaking.json when a truly major story breaks (at most one a day). One story in the same shape as a story in news.json, plus `at`. Check it with `npm run validate-news` in the-desk repo.

at.description: When the agent found it: an ISO 8601 date and time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-12-07T12:04:00-05:00 or 2026-12-07T17:04:00Z
